verdict.rationale: An API reference exists (e.g. the documented /api-reference/v1/search page with parameter descriptions), and the docs are machine-readable via llms.txt. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and every probed OpenAPI spec path returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive playground or try-it console, runnable code examples within the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
